name: Girgis Family Medicine (Dr. Moris Girgis / Dr. Linda Girgis)
website: none working (practice domain girgismd.com now serves an Indonesian gambling site; Dr. Linda also blogs at drlinda-md.com)
what_they_do: A primary-care practice at 123 Main St with two physician-specific Google profiles. Dr. Linda Girgis is a board-certified family physician who also writes widely syndicated medical commentary; Dr. Moris Girgis is listed as a family practice physician at the same office and phone. Day-to-day services (physicals, chronic care, vaccines) are conventional primary care but are not described on any working practice website.
customers: South River and surrounding Middlesex County primary-care patients; insurer directories list the practice in Fidelis, WellCare, UnitedHealthcare and Aetna Better Health networks (inference: heavy managed-care/Medicare mix).

size_signals.signal: Two separate Google Business Profiles for the same office and phone (Dr Linda 4.3, Dr Moris 4.1) - inference: two-physician practice
Listed in multiple Medicaid/Medicare Advantage provider directories
Saint Peter's HealthCare System physician profile lists Dr. Moris Girgis with office, phone and fax

Duplicate Google profiles for the same office split reviews and confuse patients/agents
No practice website, hours, services or appointment path online; phone only

agent_readiness.notes: Findable 1: profiles exist and show hours/phone, but duplicated and pointed at a hijacked domain. Answerable 0: no crawlable statement of services, insurance, hours or providers on an owned page; no JSON-LD. Bookable 0: no form or scheduling; patients must call.

operations_signals.signal: Appointments and enquiries can only come through the phone; no online intake path exists
Duplicate listings for one front desk - inference: inconsistent info given out by phone and directories

top_opportunities.opportunity: Get a working practice site back on the domain (or a new one) and take the gambling page out of the patient journey
top_opportunities.evidence: girgismd.com renders an Indonesian slot-gambling landing page and is still the website on both Google profiles

top_opportunities.opportunity: Merge the two Google profiles into one claimed listing with hours, services, insurance list and photos
top_opportunities.evidence: Two profiles, same address and phone, 4.3 and 4.1

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add online appointment requests and an after-hours answering/booking agent to cut front-desk call load
top_opportunities.evidence: No online booking anywhere; primary care phone volume (inference)

scores.reasons: Gap maxed and urgent (hijacked domain, duplicate profiles, no booking). Ability to pay moderate: insured primary care, two physicians, but thin margins. Ease high: domain recovery plus a 5-page site is quick. Evidence strong: saw the gambling page render.
